confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web-search summaries of aggregated Atlanta price sources (Numbeo, Wise, Hikersbay, Tab Tender, Expatistan and others). Restaurant meal and coffee figures cluster reasonably tightly; beer and cocktail are looser, and the cocktail figure draws on mixed-date (2025 to 2026) menu samples and blog estimates. No reliable Atlanta per-glass wine figure was found, so the wine anchor is bounded by national glass benchmarks and checked against the beer anchor (about 1.9 times beer). Cocktail is also consistent with about 2 times beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation searches were run and no live booking pages or listings were inspected. July 2026 overlaps FIFA World Cup matches in Atlanta, so the hotel and hostel anchors were nudged up modestly. Most price sources are crowd-sourced or estimate-based, not official statistics.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution. Food and drink anchors use Atlanta-specific aggregated price sources where available. Wine uses U.S. national restaurant-glass benchmarks cross-checked against the Atlanta draft beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a large U.S. metro.
